title: Learning a Food World Model That Predicts the Next State from Production Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.28319v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Food assembly robots pick ingredients from a pan, and every pick must deliver a target weight. We learn a world model of food picking from 61,773 production picks, labeled automatically by a camera and a scale (self-supervised learning). From the pre-pick heightmap of the pan on a 2.5 mm grid, the commanded pick action, the food and the utensil, the model predicts the post-pick heightmap and the picked mass with uncertainty. We evaluate the mass prediction on 12,294 held-out picks of nine foods. The production controller keeps each pick near its commanded target. The model's root-mean-square error (RMSE) of 10.93 g is 9% lower than that of the commanded target or of a per-food mean. This RMSE is 24% lower than that of the controller's internal mass estimate. translated_title: 从生产数据中学习可预测下一状态的食物世界模型
translated_abstract: 食物装配机器人从锅中拾取食材，每次拾取都必须达到目标重量。我们从61,773次生产拾取中学习了一个食物拾取世界模型，这些数据由摄像头和电子秤自动标注（自监督学习）。基于2.5毫米网格上的锅中拾取前高度图、下达的拾取动作、食物种类和器具，该模型预测拾取后的高度图以及拾取质量及其不确定性。我们在12,294次涵盖九种食物的保留拾取数据上评估了质量预测。生产控制器使每次拾取接近其下达的目标，模型的均方根误差（RMSE）为10.93克，比下达目标或每种食物平均值低9%；该RMSE比控制器内部质量估计低24%。基于20个手工特征的梯度提升树的RMSE仅低0.2克，但它们只预测质量，无法预测规划与策略学习所需的下一状态。
tldr: 该研究利用6万余次生产拾取数据的自监督学习，构建了一个能同时预测拾取后锅状态高度图和拾取质量（含不确定性）的食物世界模型，其质量预测误差比控制器内部估计低24%，并为规划与策略学习提供了所需的下一状态预测。
en_tdlr: This work learns a food-picking world model via self-supervision from 61,773 production picks that predicts both the post-pick heightmap and picked mass with uncertainty, achieving 24% lower mass RMSE than the controller's internal estimate while providing the next-state predictions required for planning and policy learning.
